children.label: 1. Card Unlock
children.body: Cards are now unlocked. Move cards freely between your Hand and Spread before taking other Winter actions.

children.label: 2. Winter Activities (optional)
children.body: Craft Reagents freely — same rules as Summer — before Card Limits are enforced. Also: place a Fateful Wager by betting cards on the next Cosmic Age's Zodiac Sign. Guess correctly and your wager is doubled. Guess wrong and it is lost to the Fates. Wagers resolve at the start of next Spring.

children.label: 3. Enforce Card Limits
children.body: Discard down to card limits before the next Age: Spread 5 cards · Hand 5 cards · Arcanum: Adept cards only (discard all Fate Major Arcana to the Common Deck).

children.label: 4. Transit the Age
children.body: The Agekeeper collects all discarded Kismeta Cards, shuffles the Common Deck, and taps it twice to cleanse it. Then pass the Agekeeper's Key clockwise to the next player. Return to Phase 1: Spring.
